I doubt even Maphr would condone such behavior... A few days ago I gave a lecture on how to capture Dwarves alive. Would you l…

trainer/30850-noteach.htm.text: Master Aiken: Regretfully, I only teach Human warriors. All masters must teach only those of their own race. I wouldn't mind helping you if just have a personal request, but it would behoove you to find another master. Here in this mighty capital of the kingdom of Aden, surely you will find a suita…

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/0-01.htm.text: Master Aiken: Warlords have always been at the forefront of major victories, from the war between Aden and Elmore to the recent conquest of the Tower of Insolence. We've had many nicknames, Terror of the Battlefield, Dragon's Descendants, and so on... Do you know which art of fighting the Warlords …

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/0-04.htm.text: Master Aiken: Guard Ulrich in Goddard Castle Town knows all the details.

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/0-06.htm.text: Master Aiken: Things were more orderly during the war with Elmore. We have entered an era of chaos. Have you met the Bride of the Fire Dragon and acquired the vision of the dragon?

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/0-09.htm.text: Master Aiken: You have proven your strength and learned the vision of the dragon. I hereby bestow upon you the title of Dreadnought, dragon descendant!

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/0-010.htm.text: Master Aiken: You must be stronger to control the energy of the dragon. To fulfill the vision in your mind you must have more experience. (Only a character of level 76 or above is allowed to do a class transfer. Do not abandon quest before transfer is complete!)

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/0-02.htm.text: Master Aiken: I heard she was somewhere up north. You should take on a task more suited to your abilities. (This quest may only be undertaken by a Warlord of level 76 or above.)

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/0-03.htm.text: Master Aiken: Meet with Guard Ulrich in Goddard Castle Town. He used to live in Giran. He sent me a letter about Leona, her battle and the fire dragon Valakas. He knows all the details. Read this book he sent me before you go.

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/0-05.htm.text: Master Aiken: Warlords studied the fighting techniques of dragons during the war of the gods. That's why we're rumored to be descended from dragons! Leona Blackbird , also known as the Bride of the Fire Dragon , was once captain of the guards in Giran. Before the era of chaos began she was defeated…

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/0-07.htm.text: Master Aiken: I felt that power in you. It can instill fear in people, but it can also help us maintain peace in this land. I hereby bestow upon you the title of Dreadnought, dragon descendant!

Q00074_SagaOfTheDreadnought/0-08.htm.text: Master Aiken: You're not strong enough to control the energy of the dragon. Come back when you have more training. (Only characters level 76 or above are allowed to do a class transfer. Do not abandon quest before transfer is complete!)

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
